tagline: A super community bank model focused on high-quality client relationships and operational efficiency across the Pacific Northwest
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary revenue driver in the traditional banking model, reflecting the efficiency of productive asset deployment. Increase of 21 bps to 3.96% in 2025 demonstrates effective management of the deposit base despite an uncertain rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and borrowing costs, expressed as a percentage of interest-earning assets.
kpis.description: Net interest margin increased to 3.96% in 2025 from 3.75% in 2024, reflecting effective management of the deposit base and earning assets.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion despite an uncertain rate environment

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of interest income and non-interest income.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $660.7 million in 2025, up 8.6% from $608.6 million in 2024, driven by net interest margin and stable fee income.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached $195.4 million in 2025, compared to $168.9 million in 2024, supported by revenue growth and disciplined cost management.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in net income in 2025

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average total assets.
kpis.description: ROA improved to 1.21% in 2025 from 1.07% in 2024, indicating more efficient use of assets.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Non-interest expenses divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: The efficiency ratio declined to 61.87% in 2025 from 64.33% in 2024, reflecting better cost control.

kpis.name: Loan Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans extended to customers.
kpis.description: Loan portfolio reached $11.56 billion at end-2025, up 3.2% from $11.20 billion at end-2024.

kpis.name: Deposit Base
kpis.explanation: Total customer deposits, the primary source of funding.
kpis.description: Deposits totaled $13.74 billion at end-2025, compared to $13.51 billion in 2024, with 89% in core deposits.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount reached 1,943 full-time equivalents at end-2025, down 13 from 1,956 in 2024.

kpis.name: Core Deposits
kpis.explanation: Proportion of stable deposits in total deposits.
kpis.description: Core deposits represented 89% of total deposits at end-2025, reflecting a stable funding composition.

kpis.name: Non-Performing Assets
kpis.explanation: Loans in default or repayment difficulty, expressed as a percentage of total assets.
kpis.description: Non-performing assets accounted for 0.31% of total assets at end-2025, compared to 0.24% in 2024, reflecting moderate pressure on portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Adverse economic conditions affecting regional markets
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the 'Risks Related to Macroeconomic Conditions' section. The language used is strong ('material adverse effect') and the context highlights significant geographic concentration (Washington, Oregon, California, Idaho), making the company vulnerable to regional economic slowdowns. The weighting is high as macroeconomic conditions are fundamental for a bank.

risks.title: Risks related to commercial and multifamily real estate loans
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the 'Risks Related to Credit and Lending' section and represents 42% of the loan portfolio. The language intensity is high, citing default risks, refinancing difficulties due to interest rates and shifts in work models (remote work). The portfolio's high weighting and commercial real estate market specifics justify a high severity.

risks.title: Risks related to construction and land development loans
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly detailed in the 'Risks Related to Credit and Lending' section, representing 15% of the portfolio. The language is intense, highlighting uncertainties in cost and future value estimates, risks of exceeding commitments, and sensitivity to real estate market slowdowns. The speculative nature of some loans and concentration among certain developers increases severity.

risks.title: Impact of monetary policy and interest rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the 'Risks Related to Macroeconomic Conditions' section and directly affects bank profitability. Uncertainty around Fed rate changes and their impact on credit demand, asset yields, and deposit costs is emphasized. While less specific than a portfolio risk, systemic exposure justifies a moderate to high severity.

ai_positioning.summary: BANR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Focus is on digital channel modernization and mobile banking, but no reference to AI.
